inspection.visual_review: Upstream screenshot shows glass-front commercial refrigerator with a separate door frame and left-side handle. Metadata confirms distinct door subtree. No new render was produced during curation.
inspection.difficulty_caveat: Named door subtree, authored pivot, and rotation animation already expose articulation cues. Suitable for adding physical collision, mass, revolute constraint and dynamics, but not a clean test of hinge inference from unlabeled static geometry. All original cues remain intact.

intended_joint_task.description: Turn the preserved refrigerator visualization into a physically constrained one-DOF door assembly without changing source mesh topology or deleting source data. Use the case as fixed rigid body and the complete FridgeDoor subtree as the moving rigid body.
intended_joint_task.task_goal: A force or torque pulse opens the door while the hinge holds its anchor, the cabinet remains fixed, and a limit stops the door. This must be physics motion rather than source animation playback.

proposed_acceptance_observables.status: proposal_for_root_protocol_freeze; not acceptance criteria already applied

observables.name: source_identity
observables.measurement: Record original GLB SHA256 and compare mesh topology/positions and source subtree membership across both experiment arms.

observables.name: physical_joint_presence
observables.measurement: Simulator reports exactly one revolute constraint between case and the complete door rigid body, with mass and collision metadata.

observables.name: impulse_response
observables.measurement: With source animation playback off, controlled torque impulse changes hinge angle and measured angular velocity while no nonhinge relative DOF drifts.

observables.name: anchor_error
observables.measurement: Log separation of parent and child hinge anchors over a fixed simulation interval; freeze numerical tolerance before arms run.

observables.name: travel_limit
observables.measurement: Apply sustained opening torque; measured joint angle remains within the predeclared interval without passing through the cabinet.

observables.name: assembly_coherence
observables.measurement: Door frame, inner panel and glass retain their relative transforms; cabinet pose remains fixed.

protocol_caveats: No physical properties have been authored during curation.
Do not count the existing 4.67-second keyframe animation as physical success.
Angle limits, inertial assumptions, impulse magnitude, time step and tolerances must be frozen by root before paired arms.
Collision approximations should preserve the visible source geometry and should be reported separately from source meshes.
